senses.gloss: that which is singled out, specification, explicit statement, opp. כְּלָל. Sifra introd., v. כְּלָל.
units: B. Kam. 54ᵇ (ref. to Deut. V, 14) מה הפ׳ מפורש בעלי חיים וכ׳ as the explicit specification (thy ox and thy ass) mentions animated beings, so the general expression (and all thy b’hemah) refers to all kinds of animals (including birds).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 123a:21">B. Bath. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>בפְרָטָן</he> in the detailed account of them, v. <cite ref="K00760"><he>כְּלָל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 25:3">I Chr. XXV, 3</cite>) <he>חמשה בפ׳ ובכללן ששה</he> in the specification there are five (sons of Jeduthun), and in the summing up it says ‘six’; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII <he>בפְרָטִים חמשה ובכלל ששה</he>; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פְּרָטוֹת</he>, <he>פְּרָטִים</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 37b:3">Sot. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>כללות … ופ׳ באוהל מועד</he> general principles were proclaimed at Sinai, and detailed laws in the Tabernacle; <cite ref="Chagigah 6a">Ḥag. 6ᵃ</cite> sq.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 32">Ex. R. s. 32</cite>, beg. Midr. Sam. l. c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: פ׳ ל־ [this is especially mentioned as against], to the exclusion of.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 64b:11">B. Kam. 64ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ למרשיע את עצמו</he> this excludes (exempts from the fine) him who accuses himself; a. v. fr.
